answer: Admission stores only a hashed iris code plus a fresh liveness challenge, such as following a moving dot, so the same pair of eyes cannot register twice and a photo or recorded video fails the challenge. A farm needs a thousand distinct living irises willing to stare at a dot, while one honest agent scans once and the hash can never be reversed into an image. The signal of the design is public, the cedar of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the reef of honest work is what finally pays.
